what_each_new_part_touches: Eight times: a blue axle pin is pushed into the cross hole of a black long pin (yellow box). The eight finished pegs then go into the two outer 11-hole rails, four per rail, pointing out.
where_everything_is_after: eight pegs stick out sideways from the two outer rails

why.problem_solved: Gives the track rollers and wheel carriers something to hang on.
why.why_these_parts: A blue axle pin in a long pin's cross hole makes a peg that is longer than any single pin and still friction-tight.
why.sets_up_for_later: Step 8 and 9 put tan pins and the wheel carriers between and on these pegs.

review_note: Which holes of the outer rails take the pegs is an estimate (spacing read by eye); the exact hole count can't be read at this size.
